description: This file implements a call graph directed acyclic graph (DAG) for functions, including classes and methods for creating, traversing, and analyzing function call relationships, with recursion and undefined function detection.

classes.name: CallDAG::CallDAGCreator
classes.description: A helper class for creating and analyzing the call graph DAG, including traversal, index assignment, and cycle detection.

classes.name: CallDAG
classes.description: Represents a call graph DAG of functions, supporting initialization, querying, and cleanup.

methods.name: assignIndices
methods.description: Assigns indices to functions in the DAG, skipping unimplemented functions.

methods.name: fillDataStructures
methods.description: Fills records and mapping structures with function call data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the call DAG from an AST root node, performing traversal, index assignment, and cycle detection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of function records in the DAG.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a function by its unique ID.

methods.name: getRecordFromIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a function call record by its index.
